title: Python DIO builder omits mandatory DODAG Configuration option (draft 9.1 'Every DIO', R-RPL-032)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 9.1 — DODAG Configuration option present in EVERY DIO. Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-032, divergent, confidence high.
Evidence (verified this sweep): python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py:375-385 build_dio() emits a bare DIO with no options; the serializer auto-inserts only the SCHC Rule Version option (rpl/messages.py:328-343). The DodagConfig codec exists (rpl/messages.py:95-167, type 4) but has no production TX caller (only vector parsing tests/test_vectors.py:3097-3100). Rust always writes it (lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:1042-1044 build_dio_with_authorization_ext), C gateway always appends it (lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c:163-203; RX parse dodag.c:667-676).
Suggested placement: attach the default DodagConfig (matching Rust DodagConfig::default() / C defaults) in Python build_dio or the serializer, plus a round-trip test asserting the option is present in every emitted DIO.
